blocks.text: Connect only on sites you trust
Use https://www.synexus.pro and verify the URL bar. SyNexus opens swap shortcuts; Phantom handles signing. If a popup appears on an unfamiliar domain, reject it.
Read token names, amounts, and program IDs in Phantom's preview. Malicious approvals often hide behind generic labels.
Many operators keep a 'burner' wallet for new mints and a separate cold or hardware-backed wallet for long-term holdings. Losses on the burner stay contained.
